criteria.name: npm run verify passes
criteria.evidence: Command 'npm run verify' executed successfully with no errors or failures reported in the output (verified via direct command execution in working tree).

criteria.name: kernel.test.cjs passes with closed-form assertions
criteria.evidence: The test file 'src/sims/markus-lyapunov/kernel.test.cjs' was executed and passed all assertions including ln(0.5), ln(2), and sequence-sensitivity checks, with proper tolerance values and genuine encoding of closed-form values.

criteria.name: Browser smoke on #/markus-lyapunov renders recognizable fractal
criteria.evidence: Headless browser test (Playwright) launched against dev server and navigated to '/#/markus-lyapunov'. The rendered view shows a clearly recognizable Markus–Lyapunov fractal with the classic swallow-curve stability filaments in the Zircon Zity view.

criteria.name: Stable/chaotic regions render with correct colour ramps
criteria.evidence: Visual inspection of rendered fractal shows stable regions (λ < 0) rendered on yellow/brown ramp and chaotic regions (λ > 0) rendered on blue/black ramp, with a visually legible boundary at λ = 0. The amber ramp for stability and ice ramp for chaos were correctly applied from colormap.ts.

criteria.name: Sequence parameter change visibly alters fractal shape
criteria.evidence: Changing the 'sequence' parameter from 'AB' to 'AABB' in the browser UI visibly reorganizes the fractal topology, demonstrating that the alternation is genuinely per-step and not collapsed to a single effective r. This was confirmed through visual comparison of two different sequence settings.

criteria.name: No files outside deliverable list are modified
criteria.evidence: Git status was checked and only files under 'src/sims/markus-lyapunov/' plus the registry entry, presets.ts addition, and colormap.ts modifications were changed. No other files in the repo were touched.

additional_findings: All acceptance criteria passed successfully, confirming that the Markus–Lyapunov fractal kernel implementation is fully functional and meets all specified requirements. The closed-form validation tests for ln(0.5) and ln(2) points confirmed accurate computation of Lyapunov exponents. The sequence parameter properly affects the fractal structure as required.
